config.method: Temperature, the abstention threshold and the gate settings are chosen on the fitting part of each dev split and scored on the scoring part. Each split is cut by near-duplicate group (field_dev by its group column, not_plant_dev one image per group) with sprout.eval.records.scoring_part, seed 0, 50% of the groups to fitting; the record's subset group_part:0:50 names the scoring part. The settings saved in results/e5/chosen.json come from the fitting part only. The final held-out estimate is T8.1's.
limits: The model, convnext_joint, was selected on field_dev, so every number here is a development number.
field_dev is seen-source: E4's held-out-source runs scored far lower on unseen sources, so calibration and thresholds fitted here may not carry over to new photo sources.
The out-of-distribution score uses only the probabilities, because the serving check receives probabilities; scores built from logits or features were not tried.
not_plant_dev is COCO 2017 val images without potted plants; it measures rejection of everyday objects, not of every non-plant photo.
